text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With the Shuka Sho in mind, Sweep Tosho 
proposed a training routine that was even 
stricter than usual.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her eyes burned with the determination to 
claim 1st place no matter what. Respecting 
that resolve, they decided to spend the 
next two full weeks immersed entirely in 
training.
